subject: Transportation Systems
title: George Stephenson's Rocket
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on George Stephenson's Rocket.

hook.text: By 1829, railway investors needed proof that steam beat horses. They staged a public contest.

buildup.text: Five locomotives entered the Rainhill Trials. Most broke down or caught fire during tests.

discovery.text: Stephenson's Rocket used a multi-tube boiler that made steam far more efficiently than rivals.

twist.text: It hit 30 mph—breathtaking when most people had never moved faster than a galloping horse.

climax.text: The Rocket won the contract and became the blueprint for every steam engine built after it.

punchline.text: One race rewrote the future of land travel.

quiz.question: What made Stephenson's Rocket win the Rainhill Trials?
options: A multi-tube boiler for efficient steam
